output.reason: [ev-2a9b9b849526] says existing services without a protocol set "will be preserved as such, to avoid any connection disruptions". They only need to be deleted and recreated if the agent is to take their protocol into account. Nothing fails, is rejected or stops working if the operator does nothing, so behavior-change (review) is right and migration-required (P4) would over-claim. The connection disruption only happens on a downgrade, which the statement correctly treats as a conditional note.
